name: exposure-architecture-2026-10-19
hypothesis: Separating signed exposure from account-path inputs may reduce portfolio-driven direction feedback. Test this against the identical two-branch layout with account connections enabled and the native full-state policy; account dependence may also be beneficial.

architecture.native: Original SB3 MlpPolicy on full 21-field observations
architecture.branches: Market branch sees seven market inputs; full branch and critic see all21. Two Tanh layers, widths32 smoke/64 research; concatenate actor branches.
architecture.unmasked: Exposure and protective outputs can use both actor branches
architecture.market_exposure: Fixed connection buffer zeros exposure row account-branch connections; learned protective outputs and critic keep account access
architecture.capacity_control: Same allocated parameter count and initialized tensors in branch arms; the mask deliberately removes active exposure connections
architecture.initialization: Use native SB3 initialization then existing wide action biases; no additional trainable parameters or RNG draw when wrapping the action head
architecture.legacy: Default native factory/models/RNG/bundle input contracts unchanged
